text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, the finale of the Senior 
Triple Crown. Having completely averted 
the "vanishing," there was nothing left to 
threaten Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to the irreplaceable rivals 
she has "connected" with up until now——

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new "connection" is about to blossom. As 
the culmination of everything so far, 
let's put on the most "fun" thing this 
year!
